author: Ankit
problem: Split the players, in list order, into two teams as evenly as possible, where the first team is never smaller than the second. Return (first_team, second_team).
bug_description: Uses len(players) // 2 for the first team's size, so with an odd number of players the second team gets the extra player.

comments.accurate: Splits players in order into two near-equal teams; the first team is never the smaller one
comments.wrong_behavior: Splits players in order into two near-equal teams; the second team takes any extra player
comments.wrong_location: Team size checked; make sure the slices don't drop or repeat a player
